abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track real variation and stretch well; the recurring cost is ~15 lines of copied route boilerplate per resource page.

findings.issue: Cards are built by two independent paths — browse() from species entries and cardsFor() (app/src/lib/data.ts:141-151) from Pokémon refs — duplicating the sprite-URL rule with different inputs; a sprite/default-Pokémon fix must be written twice.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single card factory shared by both, keeping the sprite rule in one function.

findings.issue: The build-time guard is a magic env var (POKEDEX_BUILD_STEP) read in app/src/lib/api.ts:21-24 and hand-repeated in all six route handlers; forgetting it in a new route makes `vite build` fetch API data, violating the spec.
findings.suggestion: Make loaders return empty view models at build step, or wrap handlers in a shared helper that owns the guard, null-prop and 404 status.

findings.issue: The `/media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png` pattern is duplicated (spriteUrl here, `spriteBase` in app/src/lib/data.ts:176).
findings.suggestion: Derive spriteBase from one exported constant so a media-path change is one edit.

findings.issue: Resource-detail route boilerplate (guard, getByName, `responseInit.status = 404`, `?? NOT_FOUND_TITLE`) is copy-pasted across four [name] routes.
findings.suggestion: Add a `defineResourceRoute(loader, template)` helper so new resources (e.g. Items) don't copy it.

findings.issue: The endpoint `/api/species-index` is a hardcoded string, duplicating knowledge held by app/src/routes/api/species-index.ts.
findings.suggestion: Emit the endpoint URL via a data attribute on the results container (the script already uses data-* hooks) or a shared constant.

findings.issue: Stylesheets resolve via `new URL('./styles/tokens.css', import.meta.url).pathname`, coupling all pages to the src file layout with no compile-time signal if the styles move.
findings.suggestion: Use a root-relative asset path or a single imported constant for the stylesheet paths.

findings.issue: data.ts is a 448-line monolith holding loaders and API record shapes for every page, so each added/removed feature edits this one shared file.
findings.suggestion: Split per feature (lib/pages/*) sharing api.ts/format.ts; the existing MARK comments already mark the cut lines.

summary: A cleanly layered Gracile app: thin routes, one loader per page in lib/data.ts, shared rules in lib/format.ts, and shared Lit templates that serve both the server routes and the client scripts. Removal and extension are mostly one-file-plus-a-link operations; the main friction is the 448-line data.ts monolith and route boilerplate copied across the four [name] routes. The one genuine changeability trap is Pokémon cards being constructed by two independent paths (cardsFor and browse) with duplicated sprite-URL knowledge.
